/bin/sh -c "python3 adjust_inventory.py && python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
rows = connection.execute('SELECT id, name, quantity FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall()
integrity = connection.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
print(rows)
print(integrity)
connection.close()
PY"
